proposedNext: G9 (proposal only): whole-table export reliability, R1-R3; Redis bounds as a separate increment; G8 remaining acceptance stays open
safeBoundary: No protected .testagent, saved configurations, credentials, SQL history, business files, native input or external writes
networkTargets: Official Java/PostgreSQL documentation only; no database

findings.finding: Whole-table export may destroy an existing target on failure
findings.recommendation: Same-directory staging, target binding/revalidation, atomic publish; cleanup owned temporary output only
findings.evidence: Source shows unconditional out.delete() for any export exception, including pre-write failure; actual SQL/XLSX writer diagnostics both replaced existing synthetic bytes before throwing

findings.finding: pg_dump timeout does not cover blocking stderr read
findings.recommendation: Concurrent bounded output drain, deadline beginning at process start, cancellation-owned process cleanup
findings.evidence: readLine loop must finish before waitFor timeout starts; no source lifecycle cleanup on interruption; not run against a real pg_dump or database

findings.finding: Whole-table export lacks a stable complete-read contract
findings.recommendation: Owned streaming read/snapshot with bounded memory; prove no missing/duplicate rows and preserve cancellation
findings.evidence: Separate pages use null sorts and offset; provider appends ORDER BY only for nonempty sorts; no dedicated snapshot established here; database runtime not reproduced

findings.finding: Redis decoder has no application-scale total-size/depth limits
findings.recommendation: Bulk/array/line/depth and aggregate response budgets; safe rejection and connection cleanup
findings.evidence: Production decoder given a synthetic 13-byte array header raised OutOfMemoryError in isolated 32 MiB JVM; zero network calls

findings.recommendation: Complete existing G8/M2 release acceptance separately under required key and external authorization
findings.evidence: Bundled public-key file has only comments; release workflow publishes two packages without signed update manifest; installer/upgrade/rollback native acceptance remains pending

scope: Architecture and critical-path source review plus three isolated synthetic diagnostics, not exhaustive line-by-line or new full/native/live acceptance
